Class DistributionJMCH

java.lang.Object
jmt.jmch.distributions.DistributionJMCH
public class DistributionJMCH extends Object
Manager of the service time and inter arrival time distributions for JMCH. It is encharge of converting the distribution result from the editor to a engine.random distribution.
